title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows, consolidate caches, bump actions
author: Jordan Patel
release_notes: Consolidates GitHub Actions workflows (lint/test/release) into unified pipelines; upgrades critical actions to latest stable versions; improves cache keys and parallelism to reduce CI runtime and flakiness.
description:
Background: Over the past 12 months we've accumulated a number of divergent CI workflows across the monorepo and language SDKs. This has increased maintenance burden, caused duplicated caching configuration, and added noise to release automation. This PR consolidates lint/test/release flows into a small set of shared, well-documented workflows and updates action versions for security/hygiene.

What: - Consolidate separate lint pipelines into .github/workflows/ci-lint.yml with per-package matrices. - Consolidate unit/integration test steps into .github/workflows/ci-test.yml and introduce a test-sharding strategy for large packages. - Replace multiple release workflow variants with a single .github/workflows/release.yml that supports dry-run, canary, and production release modes. - Centralize cache key helpers into .github/actions/cache-helpers and adopt composite actions for consistent cache behavior. - Bump major GH Action versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) and update node toolchain matrix to Node 20 for build/test steps where supported. - Add docs/docs/ci.md with usage and troubleshooting.

Checklist: - [x] Migrate lint steps and ensure eslint/tsc pass on a sample of packages. - [x] Implement shared cache helper and validate cache hit rates locally. - [x] Run full test matrix in the redwood package and fix failing snapshots. - [x] Add release workflow that preserves previous tagging semantics. - [x] Update SDK subrepos to reference shared workflows where possible.

Testing notes: Initial CI run surfaced lint failures due to upgraded eslint rules and a flaky integration test in redwood-sdk-python. Fixes included: (1) narrow a rule change (no-explicit-any) to dev-deps, (2) increase test timeout for a known flaky test, and (3) adjust cache key to include package-lock version to avoid stale installs. After fixes, full matrix completed successfully (see ci_checks).

Motivation: reduces duplicated YAML, improves cache hit rate, reduces overall CI runtime (~22% reduction observed on representative runs), and improves maintainability of release automation.

Follow-ups: - Roll out shared workflows to remaining smaller repos (redwood-model-registry, redwood-private-installer). - Add observability to CI metrics (cache-hit ratio, average job time) as a dashboard in SLO-tooling.

Related: Linear ENG-2245, PM-987.

Added documentation for CI usage and debug guidance
